description: Beat 5, the damaged floor basket: the payer of KIK-1037 sends a photo of a split in the weave and asks for her $240.00 back. The photo is an illustrative drawing, and the message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: Floor basket KIK-1037 arrived damaged
messages.body:
Hello,

My floor basket, order KIK-1037, arrived today with a split down the side of the weave. I've attached a photo. I'd like a refund of the $240.00 I paid.

Thanks.
